policy: Own-fleet hourly rates use the live GPU Economy median from the API's independent /gpu-prices cache. AWS is comparison metadata only. Quotes use one in-memory snapshot refreshed in the background every 15 seconds.
singlePhysicalGpu: All modes use the same hourly median and duration. No tier premium, slowdown or extra parallel card is invented.
unavailable: A missing, stale, null or nonpositive median disables task admission. GET /fleet reports null for unavailable prices. There is no AWS or static rate fallback.
pinPolicy: gpuId is optional. A supplied GPU must exist and be healthy. It is carried through planning and execution. A pinned task never silently moves to another GPU.
